canonical_source.behavior: The current source removes the active site's locally stored encrypted WordPress credential, reports success only after the removal call succeeds, and then reloads Site Settings authoritatively. The current source accepts only SiteId for removal and does not expose a caller-selected credential identifier.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The existing explicit Site Settings workspace renders secret-free credential metadata only to sites.manage members and submits a CSRF-protected DELETE with no credential ID. The controller deletes the one active tenant+site credential transactionally under a row lock, verifies absence inside the transaction, rereads authoritatively after the transaction, and flashes success only after absence is proven.

authorization.tenant_resolution: tenant.context plus exact route slug equality with server-resolved TenantContext
authorization.csrf: web middleware plus Blade @csrf and method spoofed DELETE

tenant_isolation.site_resolution: withoutGlobalScopes constrained explicitly by active TenantContext tenant_id and route site primary key
tenant_isolation.credential_resolution: withoutGlobalScopes constrained explicitly by active tenant_id plus resolved site_id

secret_safety.storage: Eloquent encrypted cast; ciphertext stored at rest
secret_safety.read_projection: id, tenant_id, site_id, username, created_at, updated_at only
secret_safety.rendering: fixed mask only; plaintext is never rendered, logged, redirected, or included in evidence

truthful_mutation_semantics.retry: manual replay is fail-closed rather than reported as a second success
truthful_mutation_semantics.cancellation: no asynchronous job or deferred provider action exists; before DELETE submission no mutation occurs

runtime_boundaries.wordpress_connector: not called; source operation removes only the local credential

acceptance_tests.coverage: canonical identity, explicit DELETE route and web/auth/tenant.context boundary, no credential ID surface, encrypted-at-rest secret, secret-free rendering, CSRF form, sites.manage authorization, tenant/site IDOR rejection, caller query tampering, transactional delete, authoritative reread, non-mutating GET, and replay 404 without fake success

generator_evidence_source.note: Immutable implementation-and-focused-test head immediately before this machine-readable evidence artifact.

terminality.basis: Real credential deletion is bound to the exact canonical operation, preserves current one-credential-per-site source semantics, and is protected by deterministic security acceptance plus authoritative persistence/reread checks.
